# Jeremiah 22 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 22:7 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-YHWH spoke judgment concerning the-kings-of Judah: their-cedar-palaces and-their-injustice and-their-exile. |
| LOGOS | The LORD spoke judgment concerning the kings of Judah: their cedar palaces, their injustice, and their coming exile. |
| PNEUMA | The LORD declared judgment against Judah's kings — their luxurious palaces built on injustice, and the exile that awaited them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
